summary_en: Mitsui Fudosan authorized the acquisition of up to 20 million shares (0.74% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 20.0 billion yen through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 9, 2026 through October 31, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns under its & INNOVATION 2030 long-term management policy.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, the Board of Directors of Mitsui Fudosan Co., Ltd. resolved to acquire up to 20.0 million treasury shares for a maximum total consideration of 20.0 billion yen. This represents 0.74% of the outstanding shares (calculated as 20,000,000 shares divided by 2,692,320,298 outstanding shares, excluding treasury stock). The acquisitions will be conducted through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange over the period from November 9, 2026 through October 31, 2027.

The company stated that the buyback is intended to enhance shareholder returns through flexible and continuous capital allocation execution, in line with the shareholder return policy outlined in its group long-term management policy & INNOVATION 2030. As of October 31, 2026, the company held 863,735 treasury shares against 2,692,320,298 outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock).
